stack.cicd: manual local signed release, notarization, and independent verification; no GitHub Actions workflow

environments.prod: public GitHub Release plus tailnet-only Tailscale Serve mirror /kltimage-preview, proxied to 127.0.0.1:8786

deploymentTarget: versioned macOS ZIPs through GitHub Releases and the existing tailnet-only Tailscale Serve mirror

deployment.visibility: public GitHub release plus tailnet-only Tailscale mirror
deployment.releasePolicy: publish each approved build at distinct versioned GitHub and tailnet paths and update advertised links only after both served copies pass independent release verification
deployment.rollback: restore trusted Build 5 as the advertised release and remove only Build 6 from GitHub Releases and the tailnet mirror; already-downloaded copies cannot be recalled
